blockingFindings.description: V75 closes the standing center-front gap, but sit and crouch still expose most of the anterior thighs as the skirt lifts and shifts aside.
Side and rear panels retain pronounced accordion-like corrugation; the seated and crouched folds remain sharp and visually distracting.
Neutral and side views retain an uneven silhouette, a long dropped center panel, and visibly ribbed side panels.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
